title: /(verification-evidence)/api/video-flag-frame
responsibility: Serve the exact retained reviewer PNG for a validated owner and flag ID, with the existing bounded range-response behavior.

inputs.name: GET.url
inputs.description: Request URL containing the owner/flag query parameters documented by this endpoint.

inputs.name: GET.request
inputs.description: Request whose optional Range header is applied to the exact retained PNG.

outputs.name: GET
outputs.description: Exact hash-verified retained PNG bytes using the existing media range response, or a JSON error.

errors.name: HTTP 400
errors.description: Invalid owner, current-slot parameters, input JSON or attached evidence/integrity produces a JSON error response.

errors.name: HTTP 404
errors.description: No retained flag belongs to this owner and flag ID.

errors.name: HTTP 416
errors.description: The existing media response rejects an unsatisfiable byte range.
